title: AfterModel output
description: Can rewrite the usage Zed records (for example the real size of a request that was shortened), which drives Zed compaction. Exit code 2 or a `decision` field is a non-blocking failure, logged with its reason. Closed: this event has no Claude Code counterpart to stay compatible with.

systemMessage.description: Warning shown to the user as a Zed notification (one per event, cut at 2000 characters), only when the output is accepted; never sent to the model.

hookEventName.description: Must be this event name; a mismatch is a hook failure.

usage.description: Usage that replaces the reported one. Zed keeps it as if the provider had sent it: a real size above the compaction threshold triggers compaction before the next request.
